scope: Nine missing Greenpeace-associated activists with actual multi-day US custody; preserve all existing profiles and hold disputed Rushmore identity.

hatfield-arrest.label: Herald-Standard, June 25, 2004, contemporaneous arrest report: Wednesday June 23 action and late-night arrest; booking early Thursday.

hatfield-prelim.label: Herald-Standard, August 3, 2004, preliminary hearing report explicitly dates the action June 23, 2004.

hatfield-sentence.label: Josh Krysak, Herald-Standard, February 16, 2005: Tuesday February 15 pleas, named individual sentences and Greene County Prison.

hatfield-served.label: Josh Krysak, Herald-Standard, April 22, 2005: explicitly confirms the six already spent time in jail. Its June 26 action date conflicts with contemporary June 23 reporting and is not used.

rushmore-journal.label: Karen Pickett, Earth First!, March 20, 1988, printed pp.1,5 / scan pp.2,6, visually reviewed: five actual thirty-day terms; Roselle probation refusal and extended jail; photograph caption dates action October 22, 1987. Chronology and fifth name conflict with later memoir.

rushmore-memoir.label: Mike Roselle with Josh Mahan, Tree Spiker, 2009, chapter 5: participant account of jail, work release and completed terms. Conflicting entry date, fifth name and institution geography withheld from structured fields.

prisoner.name: Virginia Lee Hunter
prisoner.description: Virginia Lee Hunter joined the Hatfield’s Ferry smokestack protest against the Bush administration’s energy policy and later served a five-day jail term.

cases.charges: Reckless endangerment; failure to disperse; disorderly conduct; summary criminal mischief
cases.sentence: Sentenced February 15, 2005 to five days in Greene County Prison. April reporting confirms custody completed; exact entry and release days unverified.

case_research.custody_evidence: The April follow-up confirms jail time already served, beyond initial overnight detention.

entries.custody_evidence: The April follow-up confirms jail time already served, beyond initial overnight detention.
entries.status_research: Historical custody verified. Existing profiles, cases and photos are preserved. No unsupported vital dates, coordinates, current incarceration, institutional relation or personal support website inferred. June 23 action date follows contemporary reporting; June 26 in the April follow-up is rejected. Sentence length does not determine release day. No birth year inferred from reported age.

prisoner.name: Mike Roselle
prisoner.description: Mike Roselle participated in the 1987 Mount Rushmore protest against acid rain and subsequently served time in South Dakota custody.

cases.charges: Mount Rushmore protest prosecution — individual statutory counts unverified
cases.sentence: Roselle served an extended jail term after refusing probation conditions. Both contemporary reporting and his memoir establish months of custody, but conflict on entry dates. Exact endpoints remain blank.

case_research.custody_evidence: Contemporary report confirms actual jail time; participant memoir confirms completed release.

entries.custody_evidence: Contemporary report confirms actual jail time; participant memoir confirms completed release.
entries.status_research: Historical custody verified. Existing profiles, cases and photos are preserved. No unsupported vital dates, coordinates, current incarceration, institutional relation or personal support website inferred. The March 1988 journal gives January 25 court appearance; the memoir places prison entry in December 1987. No sentencing or entry date selected. The journal names Hughes County Jail in Pierre; the memoir mistakenly places Pennington County there. Roselle reports a furlough, so no uninterrupted interval or numerical duration inferred. Fifth defendant named Richard Harris in the journal but George Harvey in the memoir is held for identity resolution. Templeton is Phillip in the journal and Flip in the memoir; surname and shared episode establish alias.
